title: Carefree, Trotting Along, Ready to Roll!

text_block_list.name: Taiyaki Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Taiyaki, hot taiyaki! Who wants fresh taiyaki~?
Only one left!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: One taiyaki, please~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Gasp!
Waaah! I-I'm so sorry! Go ahead, please, take it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
N-No, but we ordered at the exact same time!
...Oh! I know!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, piping hot and chewy, super-duper berry delicious~.
Thanks for the treat!
choice_data_list: Thanks for sharing half with me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
No way, sharing makes it taste twice as good!
Wait, so you're a Trainer from the Academy, huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
This must be fate or something!
Hope to see you around again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days after that encounter...

text_block_list.name: Meat Bun Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Steamed buns, hot meat buns! Who wants a meat bun~?
Only one left in the steamer~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: One meat bun, please~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Gasp?!
Waaah! I'm so sorr... Wait, huh?! It's you again!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehehe~, what are the odds of that?
...Wanna split this one half-and-half too? Teehee.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After repeating that little song and dance a few more times—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer!
Look, look! Check out this picture!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, guess what... I snagged a brand-new plush spider!
Isn't it just the cutest thing ever?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We'd grown close enough to exchange small talk whenever we passed each other on campus.
Then, one day...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Led by Mihono Bourbon,
a group of horsegirls were holding a joint uphill slope training session.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Slope sprint set one: completed.
Proceeding immediately to set two.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
*pant, gasp*... A-Already?! Another set?!
No waaaay...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yaaikes, this is brutal~!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
I'm... done for...! *gasp*~...!
...Ugh, and here I thought my stamina had really improved...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The horsegirls were utterly demoralized. Yet amid them all, Matikanetannhauser
was still grinding her way up that second slope, lagging behind but pushing forward.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: *pant, huff, wheeze, pant*!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Set three: adding 200 meters.
...Hah!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I-I'm not giving up either~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze, pant, huff*~... Aaargh, couldn't finish the third set~.
Bourbon-san really is incredible, isn't she—whoa, whoa!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm fine, totally fine!
My legs are just shaking like jelly. ...Man, I've still got a long way to go~.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Are you kidding? You kept pace with her until like the last 300 meters!
That's seriously amazing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon's hardcore training was famous as some of the most grueling at the academy.
In fact, almost all the other horsegirls threw in the towel after the very first rep, and yet—
choice_data_list: (She might not stand out, but she's got serious foundational grit.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days after that incident...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: *pant, huff, wheeze*...!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, haven't Rice and the others been going at it for over two hours now?
Interval training, right...? Those two are beasts.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Keep up, keep up, gotta keep... ugh...!
Nyaaah, I've hit my absolute limit...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*pant, gasp, wheeze*~...
No good~! And here I was, feeling kinda proud of my stamina...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Come on, you did amazing!
Nice fight, Machitan!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Aww, not really. Ugh...
—Wait, whoa! You're that Trainer from before!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Aww man, you caught me looking all pathetic~.
I was trying to stick with them to the very end. Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Still, I feel like I'm finally getting the hang of long-distance pacing, yeah!
That was a great workout! Better jot all this down before I forget...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should add a bit more stamina work.
I also wanna practice maintaining a low-drag running form... Munnn.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, Trainer!
Um, would you mind giving me a tiny bit of advice?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
My goal for this month is 'Build Stamina!',
so I really want to train up my slow-twitch muscles as much as I can!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking a look at the notebook she handed me... it was filled with a detailed,
pretty intense self-training plan, carefully scheduled day by day.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Eheheh~

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see, I don't really have what it takes to compete with the
best yet, but I'm not the type who can pull off crazy training either.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So, I just focus on taking it one steady step at a time~.
That way, I'm sure I'll be able to win someday!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was astonishingly positive, hardworking, and fundamentally capable.
Just watching her over the past few days made her character crystal clear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She certainly wasn't the flashy type.
Yet, depending on her future growth, she felt like someone who could truly transform.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ? Is something wrong?
choice_data_list: Would you form a contract with me?
Would you like to form a contract with me?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
A contract?
......Wait, does that mean you're offering to be my Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~! Of course! If it's with my half-and-half buddy,
you're more than welcome-come! I'm looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so began my days with Matikanetannhauser—
an "ordinary" yet delightfully quirky girl.
